content.value_statement: Writing Opentrons protocols requires precise API, labware, pipette, and module choices. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft safer Protocol API v2 workflows for Flex and OT-2 robots.
actual_capabilities: Draft Protocol API v2 scripts for Opentrons Flex and OT-2 robots.
Configure pipettes, tip racks, labware, deck slots, and robot requirements.
Build liquid handling steps for transfer, distribute, consolidate, mix, and air gap workflows.
Use module examples for temperature, magnetic, heater-shaker, thermocycler, and plate reader workflows.
Adapt included templates for basic transfer, serial dilution, and PCR setup protocols.
Explain common simulation, labware, volume, and tip management issues.
limitations: It does not connect to or control a physical Opentrons robot.
Generated protocols still require simulation and laboratory review before execution.
Robot calibration, deck setup, firmware state, and labware availability remain local responsibilities.
It does not validate biological assay design or sample safety requirements.

use_cases.title: Prepare PCR setup workflows
use_cases.description: Generate protocol drafts that distribute master mix, add samples, and run thermocycler profiles.

use_cases.title: Create serial dilution protocols
use_cases.description: Build repeatable dilution workflows across plate rows with clear volumes, tips, and mixing steps.

use_cases.title: Design module-based protocols
use_cases.description: Coordinate pipettes, deck slots, labware, and modules for automated liquid handling workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Opentrons Flex Protocol API v2 protocol that transfers 50 uL from A1 to B1 using a p300_single_flex pipette.

prompt_templates.title: Plate Dilution
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a serial dilution protocol across row A of a 96-well plate. Include diluent loading, stock transfer, mixing, and tip strategy.

prompt_templates.title: PCR Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Flex protocol that prepares 8 PCR reactions in a thermocycler. Include master mix, template DNA, comments, and cycling steps.

prompt_templates.title: Module Workflow Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Opentrons protocol for deck conflicts, pipette capacity, tip usage, module order, liquid volumes, and simulation risks.

output_examples.input: Create a basic transfer protocol for a Flex robot.
output_examples.output: A protocol plan with metadata, robot requirements, one tip rack, source and destination plates, a p300 pipette, and one transfer step.

output_examples.input: Design a PCR setup workflow for 8 samples.
output_examples.output: A workflow outline with thermocycler setup, reagent rack placement, master mix distribution, template transfer, cycling profile, and final hold.

output_examples.input: Review my serial dilution protocol before simulation.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering labware names, deck slots, pipette volume limits, tip count, transfer order, mixing settings, and expected simulation issues.

best_practices: Simulate every generated protocol before running it on a robot.
Confirm labware names, deck slots, module types, and pipette models against the local robot setup.
Use clear protocol comments and liquid labels so operators can verify each stage.
anti_patterns: Running generated protocols without simulation and laboratory review.
Using placeholder labware or pipette names without checking local hardware compatibility.
Ignoring well capacity, dead volume, tip count, or contamination control.

faq.question: Which Opentrons robots does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Flex and OT-2 protocol patterns using Protocol API v2.

faq.question: Can this skill operate my robot directly?
faq.answer: No. It drafts and reviews protocol content, but it does not connect to hardware.

faq.question: Does it include complete protocol templates?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes templates for basic transfer, serial dilution, and PCR setup workflows.

faq.question: Do generated protocols need testing?
faq.answer: Yes. Always run simulation and have a qualified operator review the protocol before execution.

faq.question: Can it help with hardware modules?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents temperature, magnetic, heater-shaker, thermocycler, and plate reader module patterns.

faq.question: Can it validate biological assay safety?
faq.answer: No. It supports protocol mechanics, but assay design and safety review require domain expertise.
